# The Flannels Pocket

> Band rehearsal companion web app for The Flannels: stems isolation, rehearsal DAW, audio analyzer, lyrics & chords, and a song request leaderboard.

The Flannels is a four-piece band (vocals, drums, guitar, bass). The Flannels Pocket is the official web app used for rehearsal and setlist management.

## Key features

- Stems isolation: practice vocals, drums, guitar, or bass individually with quick mute/solo controls
- Rehearsal DAW: browser-based multi-track playback without restarting audio
- Audio analyzer: BPM and key information curated by the band
- Lyrics & chords: reference material per song
- Song request leaderboard: audience song requests with voting-style ranking

## Usage notes

This is a client-side web application. Content is rendered in the browser; audio features require a modern browser with Web Audio API support.

Site: https://theflannels-pocket.vercel.app/
